{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season | year = 2020–21 | team = Saint Louis Billikens | sport= Basketball | image = SLU Billikens wordmark.png | conference = Atlantic 10 Conference | division = | short_conf = A-10 | CoachRank = | APRank = | record = 14–7 | conf_record = 6–4 | head_coach = [[Travis Ford]] | hc_year = 5th | assoc_coach = Corey Tate | asst_coach1 = [[Ray Giacoletti]] | asst_coach2 = [[Ford Stuen]] | stadium= [[Chaifetz Arena]] | champion = | tourney = [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result= First Round }} {{2020-21 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team''' represented [[Saint Louis University (United States)|Saint Louis University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Their head coach was [[Travis Ford]] in his fifth season at Saint Louis. The team played their home games at [[Chaifetz Arena]] as a member of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 14–7, 6–4 to finish a tie for 4th place. They defeated [[2020–21 UMass Minutemen basketball team|UMass]] in the quarterfinals of the A-10 tournament before losing in the semifinals to [[2020–21 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]]. They received an invitation to the NIT where they lost in the first round to [[2020–21 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]]. == Previous season == The [[2019-20 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Billikens]] finished the [[2019-20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019-20 season]] 23–8, 12-6 in [[2019–20 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] in fourth place. Their season ended when the [[2020 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] and all other postseason tournaments were canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
